Actually, let me revisit what happened when I clicked the reference before:
1. White slot, click reference white (row 5, col 8) -> no effect
2. Purple slot, click reference purple (row 10, col 8) -> painted top block purple
Wait, actually earlier when I had all-white blocks and clicked reference purple with purple slot, it painted the top block purple. So the pattern might be:
- Click reference's color X with slot color X -> paints the blocks in some pattern
But I need white on top, purple on bottom. Let me try:
1. SPACE with purple slot -> purple top, white bottom
2. Set slot to white
3. Click reference's WHITE part -> maybe paints top block white?
4. Result: white top, white bottom
5. Set slot to purple  
6. Click reference's PURPLE part -> maybe paints bottom block purple?
7. Result: white top, purple bottom!
But earlier step 3 didn't work (clicking reference white with white slot had no effect). Let me try again but make sure the blocks are in the right state first.
